verses.english: “Mendicants, form of the past and future is suffering,

verses.pali: Evaṁ passaṁ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṁ rūpasmiṁ anapekkho hoti;
verses.english: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple is not concerned with past form,
doesn’t look forward to enjoying future form,

verses.pali: paccuppannassa rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
verses.english: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding present form.
Consciousness of the past and future is suffering,

verses.pali: Evaṁ passaṁ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṁ viññāṇasmiṁ anapekkho hoti;
verses.english: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple is not concerned with past consciousness,
doesn’t look forward to enjoying future consciousness,

verses.pali: paccuppannassa viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotī”ti.
verses.english: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding present consciousness.”
